bio: A restaurant full of contrasts in which the simple decor is offset by a highly enticing menu. Occupying a country house just a few yards from the town’s sports hall, its traditional home cooking with plenty of modern and fusion influence comes as a pleasant surprise. Rice dishes (over 10 different options) are its speciality, with the creamy rice with rabbit and snails and the vegetable paella the pick of the bunch. Make sure you also try the superb foie gras terrine with a cinnamon galette and violet marmalade. We also recommend taking Toni’s advice when it comes to choosing your wine!...
